issues.description: Some sentences are marked as (General background knowledge) but are presented inline among institution‑level rules. When this template is copied into a course sylabus, readers could misinterpret background suggestions as formal institutional policy.
issues.required_fix: Keep the (General background knowledge) labels in the text and add a short clarifying sentence (or footnote) that these items are illustrative suggestions rather than mandated institutional rules. Ensure all institution‑specific rules (sanctions, mandatory declarations) keep explicit KB citations (already present for key items).

issues.description: Word limits for reflective declarations vary across templates in the surrounding KB (this section uses 'max. 150 words' for the student AI declaration, while other template summaries in the memory mention 'reflexe (max. 200 slov)' for sumative tasks).
issues.required_fix: Clarify in the template the purpose of each word limit and harmonize or distinguish them explicitly (e.g., 'Povinná studentská deklarace (max. 150 slov) — krátké shrnutí použití AI; samostatná reflexe procesu u sumativních úloh může mít až 200 slov, pokud to zadání vyžaduje.').

issues.description: Several visual/input fields are built with \underline{\hspace{...}} and fixed long horizontal spacings which may not render well across different document classes, page widths or when imported into some LMS systems. Footnotes are inserted inside paragraphs; this is acceptable but can cause layout issues in narrow columns.
issues.required_fix: Replace fixed \underline{\hspace{...}} constructs with more robust LaTeX constructs such as \rule{<length>}{0.4pt} or \makebox[<length>]{\hrulefill}, or use \parbox/\makebox with \hrulefill so the fill adapts to the available line width. Check footnote placement and, if needed, use \footnotemark / \footnotetext for blocks that must remain together.

issues.description: Varianta C — 'Generativní AI nástroje lze používat volně jako podpůrný prostředek' — is potentially ambiguous for instructors deciding what 'volně' means in practice (e.g., whether fully AI‑generated code/text is acceptable in summative pieces).
issues.required_fix: Add one or two brief clarifying sentences or examples (labelled as examples / background) stating expected constraints for summative work (e.g., 'If a summative task is intended to assess individual competence, specify if parts generated by AI must be accompanied by a reflective note or excluded').

issues.description: The template refers to milestone / rubric templates and a short LMS declaration, but does not include an explicit pointer to the associated rubric/template files that are available in the KB (useful for instructors who copy this into a syllabus).
issues.required_fix: Add a brief cross‑reference line such as: 'Pro rychlé nasazení přiložte rubriku pro procesní milníky a krátký formulář deklarace (viz editovatelné šablony v přílohách/prompt library).' If possible, point to the internal template identifiers (e.g., 'rubrika milestone — šablona: Rubrika pro procesní milník (3 úrovně)'). Keep as an internal reference (no external URLs invented).

suggested_edits.edit_instruction: Replace occurrences of \underline{\hspace{8cm}} and similar with a flexible rule, e.g. use \rule{8cm}{0.4pt} or \makebox[8cm]{\hrulefill} to ensure consistent rendering. For variable page widths consider using \makebox[0.8\linewidth]{\hrulefill}.

Append a clarifying parenthetical example labelled '(příklad — background)': 'Například: u laboratorních úloh může být povoleno AI‑generování návrhů, ale u závěrečných reportů nadále vyžadujeme jasné vyznačení části vytvořené AI a doplnění vlastní technické reflexe.' Mark this as general background knowledge.

Add one example sentence (as help text for LMS) showing a concise declaration format (label as 'příklad'): e.g. 'Příklad: Použil(a) jsem ChatGPT (OpenAI) pro jazykovou korekturu a úpravu struktury odstavců; vlastní věcný přínos: doplnil(a) jsem, opravil(a) a dopracoval(a) výsledný text.' Mark example as background guidance.

suggested_edits.target: Pravidla používání generativní AI — harmonizace slovních limitů
suggested_edits.edit_instruction: Add a short clarifying sentence noting the different purposes of the two word limits and harmonize wording: 'Poznámka: deklarace použití AI (LMS) — krátké shrnutí do 150 slov; u některých sumativních úloh může vyučující vyžadovat rozšířenou reflexi procesu (až 200 slov).' Ensure this aligns with other templates in the KB.

Ensure each institutional claim (sanctions, Microsoft Copilot/Forms usage, 'Pokrok v matematice', Minecraft Education) keeps the cited footnotes as present. For any general suggestions keep the '(General background knowledge)' label and remove institutional footnote markers from those lines unless a KB excerpt supports them.
